title: 1RB---_0RC0LD_1LB1RC_0LE0LF_1RD1LE_1RF1RA halts iff a block of 3 meets a block of 8 (Lean)
text: Lean (kernel only) proves that this machine halts from blank tape iff its block map ever cuts a block down to exactly 3 cells next to a left neighbour of exactly 8: a block of m cells with i on its left, m a multiple of 3 and i + 2m/3 = 10. The proof is an invariant on block sizes and on the block that collects cells behind the zigzag. In 2.5·10<sup>11</sup> frames the left neighbour is never 8, and small neighbours away from the left end occur only in the first 10<sup>8</sup> frames.
